// Field preserves absent, null and present values; mapping revision: see ProtocolRevision.
type Field[T any] struct {
	value   T
	present bool
	null    bool
}

// Present preserves zero, false and empty values as present on the wire.
func Present[T any](value T) Field[T] { return Field[T]{value: value, present: true} }

// Null creates an explicit null. The enclosing schema must permit null.
func Null[T any]() Field[T] { return Field[T]{present: true, null: true} }

func (value Field[T]) IsZero() bool    { return !value.present }
func (value Field[T]) IsPresent() bool { return value.present }
func (value Field[T]) IsNull() bool    { return value.present && value.null }
func (value Field[T]) Get() (T, bool)  { return value.value, value.present && !value.null }

func (value Field[T]) MarshalJSONTo(encoder *jsontext.Encoder) error {
	if value.null || !value.present {
		return encoder.WriteToken(jsontext.Null)
	}
	return json.MarshalEncode(encoder, value.value)
}

func (value *Field[T]) UnmarshalJSONFrom(decoder *jsontext.Decoder) error {
	body, err := decoder.ReadValue()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if body.Kind() == 'n' {
		*value = Null[T]()
		return nil
	}
	var next T
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &next); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	*value = Present(next)
	return nil
}

// Number retains an exact JSON token; mapping revision: see ProtocolRevision.
type Number string

// NewNumber accepts bounded JSON numbers without conversion through float64.
func NewNumber(token string) (Number, error) {
	if len(token) == 0 || len(token) > 256 || !jsontext.Value(token).IsValid() || jsontext.Value(token).Kind() != '0' || strings.TrimSpace(token) != token {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("protocol: invalid or oversized numeric token")
	}
	if at := strings.IndexAny(token, "eE"); at >= 0 {
		exponent, err := strconv.ParseInt(token[at+1:], 10, 64)
		if err != nil || exponent < -1024 || exponent > 1024 {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("protocol: numeric exponent exceeds magnitude 1024")
		}
	}
	return Number(token), nil
}

func (value Number) MarshalJSONTo(encoder *jsontext.Encoder) error {
	if _, err := NewNumber(string(value)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return encoder.WriteValue(jsontext.Value(value))
}
func (value *Number) UnmarshalJSONFrom(decoder *jsontext.Decoder) error {
	body, err := decoder.ReadValue()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	next, err := NewNumber(string(body))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	*value = next
	return nil
}

//go:embed bindings.json
var protocolBindings []byte

// SchemaBinding records one public declaration; mapping revision: see ProtocolRevision.
type SchemaBinding struct {
	Definition  string `json:"definition"`
	Pointer     string `json:"pointer"`
	GoName      string `json:"go-name"`
	Disposition string `json:"disposition"`
}

// SchemaBindings returns a copy of the generated API/coverage correspondence.
func SchemaBindings() ([]SchemaBinding, error) {
	var result []SchemaBinding
	err := json.Unmarshal(protocolBindings, &result)
	return result, err
}

// schemaState owns a finite generated input, never application response data.
// Cache identity and validator differential obligations are qualified in R4.
var schemaState struct {
	once    sync.Once
	adapter *validation.Adapter
	err     error
}

func validateBinding(pointer string, body []byte) error {
	if len(body) > 8<<20 {
		return fmt.Errorf("protocol: frame exceeds 8 MiB")
	}
	schemaState.once.Do(func() {
		decoder := jsonv1.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(protocolSchema))
		decoder.UseNumber()
		var document any
		if schemaState.err = decoder.Decode(&document); schemaState.err != nil {
			return
		}
		// Only generated pointers can reach this helper. Bound retention by the
		// number of nodes in this immutable input, not by caller-supplied keys.
		var count func(any) int
		count = func(value any) int {
			n := 1
			switch value := value.(type) {
			case map[string]any:
				for _, child := range value {
					n += count(child)
				}
			case []any:
				for _, child := range value {
					n += count(child)
				}
			}
			return n
		}
		schemaState.adapter = validation.New(count(document))
		schemaState.err = schemaState.adapter.Register("https://schema.invalid/mcp.json", document)
	})
	if schemaState.err != nil {
		return schemaState.err
	}
	// Standard syntax checks reject duplicates, malformed Unicode and trailing
	// data before the validator's exact-number decoding can normalize anything.
	decoder := jsontext.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(body))
	if _, err := decoder.ReadValue(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := decoder.ReadToken(); err != io.EOF {
		return fmt.Errorf("protocol: trailing JSON content")
	}
	identity := fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte(pointer)))
	compiled, err := schemaState.adapter.Compile(identity, "https://schema.invalid/binding/"+identity, map[string]any{
		"$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
		"$ref":    "https://schema.invalid/mcp.json" + pointer,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	exact := jsonv1.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(body))
	exact.UseNumber()
	var instance any
	if err := exact.Decode(&instance); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return schemaState.adapter.Validate(compiled, instance)
}

func marshalOwned[T any](encoder *jsontext.Encoder, pointer string, value T) error {
	body, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateBinding(pointer, body); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return encoder.WriteValue(body)
}

func unmarshalOwned[T any](decoder *jsontext.Decoder, pointer string, value *T) error {
	body, err := decoder.ReadValue()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateBinding(pointer, body); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var next T
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &next); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	*value = next
	return nil
}

func marshalUnion(encoder *jsontext.Encoder, pointer string, body jsontext.Value) error {
	if err := validateBinding(pointer, body); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return encoder.WriteValue(body)
}

func unmarshalUnion(decoder *jsontext.Decoder, pointer string, value *jsontext.Value) error {
	body, err := decoder.ReadValue()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateBinding(pointer, body); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	*value = body.Clone()
	return nil
}

func decodeVariant[T any](body jsontext.Value, pointer, kind string) (T, error) {
	var value T
	if err := validateBinding(pointer, body); err != nil {
		return value, err
	}
	// A type-array branch shares the parent's pointer, so check its own kind.
	if kind != "" && !strings.Contains(kind, "|") {
		matches := false
		switch kind {
		case "string":
			matches = body.Kind() == '"'
		case "boolean":
			matches = body.Kind() == 't' || body.Kind() == 'f'
		case "null":
			matches = body.Kind() == 'n'
		case "object":
			matches = body.Kind() == '{'
		case "array":
			matches = body.Kind() == '['
		case "number":
			matches = body.Kind() == '0'
		case "integer":
			if body.Kind() == '0' {
				number, ok := new(big.Rat).SetString(string(body))
				matches = ok && number.IsInt()
			}
		}
		if !matches {
			return value, fmt.Errorf("protocol: value does not match %s branch", kind)
		}
	}
	err := json.Unmarshal(body, &value)
	return value, err
}
